# HEM v0.7.4 — Detailed trends, complete removal and adaptive control

This stable release brings the v0.7.4 beta improvements to all installations and corrects the history gaps caused by using compact dashboard previews as detailed charts.

## History and trends

- Opens room-average and mold charts with their retained detailed observations. A 24-hour view no longer inherits only about 10 average points or 13 mold points from a preview compressed across a full week.
- Loads detailed history only for the opened chart through the authenticated HEM WebSocket API. The continuously updated dashboard remains compact, with no additional Recorder queries or startup database work.
- Preserves actual missing values, contributor changes and restart boundaries. Short missing mold observations survive the normal sampling interval; historical mold estimates retain the inputs and calibration used when recorded.
- Keeps individual sensors on Home Assistant's recorded history and shows explicit unavailable intervals at their actual event boundaries. Historical readings remain inspectable when the current value is unavailable.
- Keeps HEM history bounded and compatible with existing saved data. Room averages and derived mold history use HEM storage; native sensor history continues to follow Home Assistant Recorder configuration.

## Removing HEM

- Permanent config-entry removal deletes the entry's 16 owned storage journals, including environmental history, controller recovery, PID and calibration state, presence, arrival preparation, wake tracking and window advice cooldowns.
- Stops writers before deleting their files and cancels their pending writes so removed files are not recreated. Reloading, restarting or disabling HEM preserves these journals.
- Dismisses owned persistent notifications and removes the integration-added frontend script registration after the last entry is removed. Other HEM entries, source integrations, user dashboards and Recorder data are preserved.
- Documents the separate steps for removing the configured integration, deleting its installed files and handling dashboard cards or Home Assistant history.

## Window advice and earlier beta improvements

- Adds **Wait before suggesting window closure (min)** under **Home → Ventilation** at the Basic settings level. The default is **5 minutes**, the range is **0–60 whole minutes**, and **0 disables** the delay.
- Starts the room's interval only after a window actually opens following HEM opening advice. Ordinary closure advice waits even if outside conditions are unsuitable. Remaining time survives reloads and delayed source startup; expiry reassesses current conditions. Device protections and departure reminders remain active.
- Includes adaptive PID learning from normal device operation and short cycles, exact PID input handling, bounded proposals and recovery, cumulative Basic/Advanced/Expert settings levels, lifecycle and startup improvements, clear optional AQI sources and activity indicators.
- Includes completed translation coverage in all 38 supported languages and the removal of duplicate quiet controls across supported device modes. Existing entity IDs, configuration and native option values remain compatible. Automated coverage does not certify native-speaker review of every translation.

Update through HACS, restart Home Assistant to load the integration, and reload the dashboard. Beta versions do not need to be enabled for this stable release.
